JobCreateRequest.description:
Pydantic model for POST /v1/jobs.

Maps a Skyward Engine artifact request into a validated worker payload.

derived_outputs.description: Optional derived layers emitted into the same run manifest.
derived_outputs.title: Derived Outputs

product.description: Optional product envelope for canonical contracts. For product.id=lfr, product.mode is required. For product.id=midthor and product.id=midlfr, mode is optional but validated when provided. For product.id=nowthor, mode must be hourly. For product.id=hres_fwi, mode must be daily and source.layout must be existing_cog_collection. For product.id=radar_updrafts, mode is 10min.

run.description: Optional run-level collection semantics. Required for hres_fwi existing COG collection jobs to declare run_date, forecast_dates, and latest promotion.

run_id.description: Optional client-supplied run identifier. When omitted, the server infers a run_id from canonical context and source metadata.
run_id.title: Run Id

spatial_filter.description: Optional WGS84 clipping filter applied to all requested outputs. Pass a GeoJSON Polygon, MultiPolygon, Feature, FeatureCollection, or an s3:// URI to a GeoJSON file.
spatial_filter.title: Spatial Filter

target.description: Normalized target envelope (output routing and overwrite policy).

temporal_filter.description: Optional UTC time window for time_series sources.

JobCreateRequest.title: JobCreateRequest

style.description: Optional style override for styled outputs. Omit for the product default, pass a s3:// or https:// URI string, or pass an inline style document object.
style.title: Style

id.description: Optional canonical product identifier. Supported: goes_na_dayconvection, goes_na_lightningcast, goes_na_precipitation_estimate, hres_fwi, lfr, midlfr, midthor, nowthor, radar_updrafts, thor.
id.title: Id

mode.description: Optional product mode. Required for product.id=lfr (daily|hourly). Supported for product.id=midlfr and product.id=midthor (daily|hourly). Supported for product.id=nowthor (hourly), product.id=hres_fwi (daily), and product.id=radar_updrafts (10min).
mode.title: Mode

region.description: Optional product region segment. Required for hres_fwi when not using the default NA region.
region.title: Region

forecast_dates.description: Expected forecast-date tokens for run-level source collections, each formatted as YYYYMMDD.
forecast_dates.title: Forecast Dates

promote_latest.description: Whether the job may promote latest.json after all expected artifacts and manifest rows succeed.
promote_latest.title: Promote Latest

run_date.description: Run date token for run-level source collections, formatted as YYYYMMDD.
run_date.title: Run Date

layout.description: Declared source layout contract. time_series and single_frame are NetCDF layouts; existing_cog_collection is currently supported for HRES FWI archive COG inputs.
layout.title: Layout

uri.description: Local path or s3:// URI to the source NetCDF file.
uri.title: Uri

variables.description: Ordered list of source variables. For time_series or single_frame, pass one or more exact NetCDF variable names.
variables.title: Variables

output_bucket.description: Optional output destination bucket override. Allowed only when the service is configured with an S3 output backend.
output_bucket.title: Output Bucket

output_prefix.description: Optional output partition prefix. When omitted for recognized canonical products, the server infers prefix defaults from source metadata.
output_prefix.title: Output Prefix

overwrite.description: Allow overwriting existing artifacts at the output prefix.
overwrite.title: Overwrite

summary_uri.description: Canonical s3:// URI for the matching radar-updraft JSON summary.
summary_uri.title: Summary Uri

type.description: Polygonized candidate-region layer paired with the radar raster.
type.title: Type

parameters.description: Optional case-sensitive retry key: 1-128 safe ASCII characters matching [A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:-]*. Reuse only with the same public JSON payload. Bindings have the same non-sliding 14-day retention as job records.

schema.description: Optional case-sensitive retry key: 1-128 safe ASCII characters matching [A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:-]*. Reuse only with the same public JSON payload. Bindings have the same non-sliding 14-day retention as job records.
schema.title: Idempotency-Key
